note: The same card and flags as r2026-10-13-a, so the only difference from that run is the worker binary rebuilt by r2026-10-27-f. Two things to read. (1) The worker log's head line, which now fires on the run's last frame (frame 29) rather than frame 0, and prints `serve: head <low>..<high> mean <m>; residual mean R G B (rgb, head/4), logit mean L; non-finite N of M; first 8 ...`. The residual mean is head.rgb/4, the quantity the composite adds to the proxy: compare its sign and magnitude against NGX's measured delta on this card (MAD 18.4345, PSNR 21.589 dB) and against the port's own 13-a delta (MAD 6.7205, PSNR 28.800 dB). The open question is whether the head is positive where NGX's residual is negative - if so the +9R/+4G/+6B offset is the network's input preprocessing, not the composite. (2) The usual pair: mean absolute difference and PSNR of after.png against pass14/after.png, quoted next to '2560x1440 synthetic card, index 29'. Quote the stamp line from the worker log too, so the numbers are tied to the patch that produced them.
